Strings.addon.title: Back to Ship
Strings.addon.description: Compass arrows and distances back to your landed ship, your parked SRV, and a spot you mark yourself, with time to get there at your current speed. Works on foot and in the SRV.
Strings.ui.straight_ahead_distances_are_along_th: ▲ = straight ahead. Distances are along the surface; height differences aren't included.
